description: Ladderback's state: each plan with its next run and last operation, the operations queued or running, this program's build and, in connect mode, the daemon's build, sign-in state and exposure.
name: status
title: Status

description: The configured plans, a page at a time: each with its repository, whether it has a schedule, its next run and its configuration warnings.

cursor.description: The `next` of the page before, to list the page after it.

limit.description:
How many to list, a whole number from 1 to 200; 50 when not given. A
larger number lists 200, and 0 lists 1.

name: list_plans
title: List plans

description: The configured repositories, a page at a time: each with its location, credentials masked, where its password comes from, whether it is maintained here and its configuration warnings. Never a secret.

cursor.description: The `next` of the page before, to list the page after it.

limit.description:
How many to list, a whole number from 1 to 200; 50 when not given. A
larger number lists 200, and 0 lists 1.

name: list_repositories
title: List repositories

description: One repository's snapshots, newest first, a page at a time, read from the repository; only those of a plan, or taken on a host, when either is named.

cursor.description:
The `next` of the page before, asked with the same filters, to list
the page after it.

host.description:
Only the snapshots taken on this host, by its name exactly as the
snapshots give it.

limit.description:
How many to list, a whole number from 1 to 200; 50 when not given. A
larger number lists 200, and 0 lists 1.

plan.description:
Only the snapshots of this plan, by its ID: those whose
`ladderback-plan:` tag names it.

repository.description: The repository, by its alias, as `list_repositories` names it.

name: list_snapshots
title: List snapshots

description: The history of operations, newest first, a page at a time, running ones included: each with its status, times, warning codes and, when it failed, why.

cursor.description: The `next` of the page before, to list the page after it.

limit.description:
How many to list, a whole number from 1 to 200; 50 when not given. A
larger number lists 200, and 0 lists 1.

plan.description: Only this plan's operations, by its ID.

name: list_operations
title: List operations

description: One operation: its summary, why it failed when it did, and the first 100 warnings it recorded.

operation.description: The operation's ID, as `run_plan` or `list_operations` names it.

name: get_operation
title: Get operation

description: Queues a backup of a plan now, under the plan's overlap policy, and returns its operation's ID. Its hooks and secret sources run as for any other run.

plan.description: The plan's ID, as `list_plans` names it.

name: run_plan
title: Run plan

description: Waits until an operation finishes or the timeout passes, then returns whether it finished and the operation as get_operation does; when its warnings are too many to read, none are listed, unlisted-warnings is absent and its warning-codes still name them. Sends progress notifications when the call asks for them. Cancelling the call stops the wait, not the operation.

operation.description: The operation's ID, as `run_plan` or `list_operations` names it.

timeout.description:
How many seconds to wait at most, a whole number from 0 to 600; 60
when not given. A larger number waits 600; 0 reads the operation once.

name: wait_operation
title: Wait for operation

description: Asks a queued or running backup to stop, however it started; it then ends as cancelled. Maintenance can't be cancelled from here.

operation.description: The backup's ID, as `run_plan` or `list_operations` names it.

name: cancel_operation
title: Cancel operation

description: Tries each location of a configured repository, as a backup would choose among them, and tells each one's outcome. Records nothing.

repository.description: The repository's alias, as `list_repositories` names it.

name: test_repository
title: Test repository

description: What a forget of a repository maintained here would let go, by each plan's retention, and what it leaves alone. Reads the repository; deletes nothing.

repository.description: The repository's alias, as `list_repositories` names it.

name: preview_forget
title: Preview forget

description: What importing a rustic profile, given as its TOML text, would add: the repository's name, the plans and what the import couldn't carry over. Saves nothing and reads no file; profiles it uses are named in a notice.

content.description:
The rustic profile's TOML itself, never a path: no file is read, and
the profiles it uses are named in a notice.

repository.description: The alias the profile's repository would be saved under.

name: preview_import
title: Preview import

description: A plan as a profile the stock rustic reads, and what the export left out. A password stored in the configuration is refused, never written out; the password command and every hook are left out, each named in a notice.

plan.description: The plan's ID, as `list_plans` names it.

name: export_profile
title: Export profile
